name: GR 14 Parcours Principal
description_md:
The GR 14 Parcours Principal is a waymarked hiking route in BE. It covers a distance of 261.4 km with 7010 m of ascent and 7041 m of descent.

The national waymarked hiking network route is signposted as GR 14 and follows the official route published by ign_bdtopo. Walking time is about 84 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and difficulty is moderate, derived from distance and ascent. Nearby places include House of Bouillon within 100 m, Stavelot within 300 m, and Zum Haller within 1600 m.
